title: Freescale Semiconductor engineers aboard MH370

tellings.quote: Among the documented passengers on the MH370 flight were 20 engineers from Freescale Semiconductor,

plain: Michels says that among the listed passengers on MH370, the Malaysian airliner that vanished in 2014, were 20 engineers from Freescale Semiconductor, a chip company. He tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about American scientists going missing, where it serves as one more case of technical experts disappearing together.
